answer: In PoA, reputation scores undergo exponential temporal decay with a defined half-life, so an identity must provide sustained, reciprocated honest service to retain weight. EigenTrust factorization propagates trust through reciprocal links, while temporal weighting suppresses stale endorsements. A freshly spawned sybil therefore has near-zero eigenvector centrality: its isolated vault is a hollow kernel, unable to accumulate enough transitive support to pass consensus.
